title: Pattern ledger
description: pattern-ledger.json in the state directory (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.5), written by extract.mjs (FE-02): conventions, measured relationships, domain conventions and facts drawn from the captured reference pages. A pattern rests on at least two unrelated references unless it is a single measured fact. Never carried downstream: pixels, logos, names beyond plain text, copy, imagery, licensed font files, exact brand hexes, one site's full section sequence (ARCHITECTURE.md P1, FD09).

excluded.description: What was observed and deliberately not carried, as text or as {what, why, ref} objects.

page.description: The one reference page captured on this site, the closest to the surface being built.

receipt.description: Path of the capture-gate receipt (robots, terms review, SHA-256 manifest).

purged.description: true once the raw captures were deleted, with a deletion receipt.

values.description: The measured values behind the statement (ratios, counts, steps), never a brand's exact hexes or a site's text.

from.description: Reference ids; at least two unrelated references unless kind is fact.

not_borrowed.description: What the pattern deliberately leaves behind.
